title: All-Fours - A 2v2 competitive card game
author: Buzzb
selftext:
Good day all,

My app is called All-Fours All Stars and is a free game currently on the Play store.

All-Fours is a highly addictive and competitive 2v2 card game, very popular in the Caribbean.

You work with your teammate to execute your strategy based on the luck of your hands.

Some unique aspects of the game: 

1. Communicate with your teammate using gestures. However, everyone sees the gestures you make so be careful not to sell out yourself.
2. Lucky kick cards when dealing (6, J, A). Kicked suite is Trump and the most powerful suite of the round.
3. Having Jack of Trump is a risk. Points for getting away, but the enemy team is coming for you.
4. Got the Trump Hangers (Q, K, A)? Go for their Jack!

This is a game of passion for me and I have sunk a lot of time and some money into building this. Unfortunately by design, the game needs 4 players together at the same time to play one game. This is my limitation as I am struggling to get a large player base together all at once.

There is a daily call to action at 10:00pm UTC. I really hope you guys can turn out and support.
